hero.subtitle: We create a safe, accessible, and inspiring environment for women traveling across the Kyrgyz Republic.

about.title: WHY AIYM PATH WAS CREATED
about.description: A pilot project funded through the internal Competitive Fund for Gender Equality and Social Inclusion (GESI) of the Aga Khan Foundation (AKF). GESI is one of AKF's key priorities, and this initiative was developed to empower women and build safe, equitable tourism communities in Kyrgyzstan.

genderBalance.title: Industry Gender Balance
genderBalance.description: Educational events for the entire tourism sector, including men — ensuring comfort and safety for female travelers.

womenEmpowerment.title: Women Empowerment
womenEmpowerment.description: Training young women as guides and tour leaders, supporting self-employment and small business launches in tourism.

routeMapping.title: Route Mapping
routeMapping.description: Trekking routes, guesthouses, and services around Bishkek are mapped digitally with female-friendly markers.

guides.subtitle: Professional guides and tour agents who make your journey comfortable, safe, and unforgettable.

concept.intro: This is an approach to tourism development where women's safety, comfort, and preferences are factored in at every stage of the journey — from route planning and stays to guiding and services.
concept.kyrgyzstanContext: For Kyrgyzstan, this is especially important: the country possesses immense potential for natural and cultural tourism, but female travelers need clear information regarding safety, accommodation standards, routes, and accessible services.
concept.femaleFriendlyOffers: Female-Friendly helps make the travel environment more welcoming and comfortable for women:
points: Verified guest houses and travel services;
Clear insights on route specifics and potential risks.

locations.title: PROJECT TERRITORY
locations.subtitle: At launch, our focus is centered on verified trails and services across three premier destinations:

alaArcha.title: Ala-Archa Gorge
alaArcha.desc: Scenic hiking trails near Bishkek with established basic infrastructure and alpine vistas.

alamedin.title: Alamedin Gorge
alamedin.desc: Picturesque nature paths leading to mountain waterfalls and geothermal hot springs.

chunkurchak.title: Chunkurchak Valley
chunkurchak.desc: High alpine plateau offering panoramic Chui valley views and family-friendly eco-services.

cta.title: JOIN THE AIYM PATH INITIATIVE!
cta.description: Support the growth of female-friendly tourism in Kyrgyzstan and help build exceptional experiences for female travelers.

footer.description: Platform for safe, inspiring, and accessible female-friendly tourism in Kyrgyzstan.
